about: VFX-8 (the VFX track's Part 2): how the battle plays a move, as data (logic/battle-anims.js builds a move's timeline from it; battle-anim-run.js plays it on the stage). A move plays its anim (moves.json, a family or a scene id), else the default for its outcome or category (defaults). A timeline is intro then the family's steps; at is stage ms (the battle speed already scales the stage clock); n and every repeat a step; if lists gates that must all hold (a ! in front: must not): H, S, X (the category), self, protect, dmg, landed (no miss, Guard or block), power80 (power at least bigPower), gl (the 3D stage), motion (not Reduced motion). types keeps a step to those move types. Colours are named in colors, or type (the move type's colour, types.json). The six legacy families are the choreographies battle-stage.js had before VFX-8, step for step (H, S and X by category; a miss, Guard and a blocked move); VFX-11 replaces them with the 16 families. A family's short (a variant for the Faster speed, speed at least shortSpeed) is optional. maxMs: the longest a move may play, by outcome and category (the times moves took before VFX-8; a long move or a scene may add extraMs). dur and hit: what the stage returns to battle.js (hit 999: no hit; the plates repaint at hit). budgets (VFX-9's, data since VFX-12; the Studio's Battle effects tunes them): by the battle's quality 0-3, the particles alive in the one pool (ambient ones at most a quarter), a burst's most, the effect lights (lightsPhone at most on a phone, lightsAll battle lights in all). smears (Part 1's dials, VFX-1..VFX-5; data since VFX-12, logic/smear.js smearDialsSet): a throw's afterimages (fade, how much is drawn; glow, how much brighter) and a lunge's, the ribbon (its places, half width at the head in metres, twist, brightness, white core share, fray, erosion steps), a dash's ribbon (half width as a share of the Billie's height, its bounds), the stretch (from what pace, how far, at most) and a lunge's lean (per px/ms, at most, moving back).

legacy_hit.about: category H: a lunge (afterimages; a dash's ribbon, logic/smear.js), dust, the hit at 200 ms

legacy_cast.about: category S: rings on the attacker, a straight beam (Electric, Psychic, Water), 9 type icons lobbed 34 ms apart, the hit at 500 ms

legacy_status.about: category X: 10 type icons converge on the target (on the attacker for a move on itself), a ring at 600 ms

legacy_miss.about: a miss: the lunge (H) or 6 icons flung past (S, X); the target sidesteps, 'Miss'

legacy_guard.about: Guard (a move with fx.protect): rings round the attacker

legacy_blocked.about: a move into a Guard: a ring on the target, its block pose, 'Hedged'

charge.about: VFX-11: a run-up and a full-body hit: a long lunge, dust at the feet, the kit's impact

dash.about: VFX-11: too fast to see: a dash's afterimages and ribbon (VFX-5, the dash list's moves), then the hit

dive.about: VFX-11: up and out of view, then down from above onto the target

strike.about: VFX-11: a close punch, jab, drill or squeeze: a short lunge and an impact burst (an aimed move's on its part)

slash.about: VFX-11: arcs across the target: a slash arc (two on a big move), sparks along it

quake.about: VFX-11: the ground: a stomp that shakes the stage, rocks falling, a dust ring and a thud at the target

flurry.about: VFX-11: hits in a row: three quick lunges, an impact each

shot.about: VFX-11: a projectile on the kit's path with a trail, lighting the stage as it flies; a drain flies back

beam.about: VFX-11: a held ray: the attacker charges (a ring closing in), then a strip from one to the other with its caps

breath.about: VFX-11: a cone or a jet: the kit's bits poured from the attacker at the target

wave.about: VFX-11: rings and pulses outward: rings travel from the attacker to the target; a heal's light comes back. 880 ms, so Premonition (H, a delayed hit: nothing lands on its turn) fits

storm.about: VFX-11: many things over an area: the kit's bits rain and whirl over the target (each foe on a spread move)

buff.about: VFX-11: an aura and rising chevrons on the attacker, in the kit's colours

hex.about: VFX-11: at the foe: the kit's bits fly over, close round it, a ring; a stat drop's chevrons fall

guard.about: VFX-11: a shield: the hex shield comes up round the attacker, rings in the guard's colour

heal.about: VFX-11: sparkles rising, a mint light

moods.about: VFX-15: the battle's mood, over the place's (engine/post-effects.js's grade pass; battle-stage-look.js tweens it on the stage clock, logic/battle-stage-look.js picks it). A landed move of power bigPower or more, or a super-effective hit, darkens the stage by dark (at most .2) and tints it to its type's glow (tint: how much) or, a Bureau bot's, to bureau; in over inMs at the hit, out over outMs to the move's end. wave: the rows of the picture swing sideways (EarthBound's battle backgrounds) for the types listed and a Bureau bot's moves: px (bigPx on a big move) whole pixels, rows rowPx tall, speed radians a stage ms. heat: the grade's heat shimmer for these types' big moves. Under Reduced motion: the darken and tint only, stepped (no wave, no shimmer).

weather.about: VFX-15: the walk weather on the battle stage (walk/fountains-weather.js drawWeather, with battle-stage-look.js): rain's splashes on the stage's ground (splash a second at full rain, within r metres of the stage's middle; ripples instead on water), snow and ash settling there (each flake that lands within r stays ms, at most cap), the sun (the battle's sunny weather) warming the grade (warm) and its shafts (rays times), and the Sandstorm's streaks in the weather's batch (n at full strength, gust times more for gustMs when it starts, in colors).

scars.about: VFX-15: battle scars, marks on the ground for the battle (walk/battle-scars.js, one draw): one per hit at the target's feet of the kind its type names (types), a sand drift for the Sandstorm's hurt (sandstorm), a dent for a heavy hit of any other type (hitWeight at least heavy; heavy kinds); one more on a KO. At most cap by the battle's quality (0-3), the oldest replaced; m metres across, at most maxM; never on water. Gone in fadeSteps dithered steps over fadeMs when the battle ends. sprite: VFX-10's decal (sprites, a mark on the ground at 32 px/m; its size is the picture's); ramp: what colours its greys (ramps); color: its tint where the ramp doesn't resolve, and a stand-in's when the picture is missing.

artAbout: VFX-10: the effect art. sprites: each strip in game/art/battle/anims/ID.png (tools/build-battle-anims.py draws them; the Studio's Art browser edits them), frames side by side, in 8 greys (36, 64, 96, 128, 160, 192, 224, 255: index 0-7, 7 the white core). cell: one frame in px; frames; anchor: the px (from the top left) that sits on the effect's place; fps (12); impact: its first two frames at 24 fps; loop: plays round (else it plays once, ending with its life); ground: a mark on the ground at 32 px/m (VFX-15's scars), else a texel is a stage pixel at its depth (the rigs' size). ramps: what colours a sprite: grey index i is the ramp's step i (0-6), 7 stays white; ramp an NW_PALETTE ramp (game/art/next/palette.js) or 8 hexes; light: the colour it lights the stage with (type: the type's glow, types.json). iconSprites: the old icons.png particles the stage draws with a strip instead (like for like), and the ramp an untyped one takes (a typed one takes its type's).

droplet.about: a drop of water, then its splat

chip.about: a chip of rock or wood, tumbling

chevron.about: a double chevron, rising (a stat up; flipped, down)

paper.about: a square form (the Bureau), flipping; grey lines, no words

burst.about: an impact: a flash, rays, then the rays eroding

hit_spark.about: sharp lines out of the hit point

splash_crown.about: a splash rising in a crown

smoke.about: a puff of smoke, growing and wearing away

dust.about: dust kicked up both ways along the ground

flame_tongue.about: a tongue of flame, licking up

heal_sparkle.about: three sparkles rising, one after another

stamp_frame.about: the Bureau's stamp frame slamming in (its word is the style track's text)

explosion.about: an explosion: white, then billowing and eroding

shock_ring.about: a shock ring spreading and eroding

shield_hex.about: a hex shield coming up from the middle, then breaking up

beam_cap.about: a beam's end: a glowing disc with spikes

beam_strip.about: a beam's body, tiling along its length (x), scrolling

scar_crack.about: cracks in the ground (Ground), from above

scar_dent.about: a dent (a heavy hit), from above

Bureau.about: the Bureau's bots and agents: the red family of the style track's stamp ink (#EA5974), with ink

up.about: a stat rising (the colour code's teal)

down.about: a stat falling (the colour code's red)

growth.about: VFX-16: a level-up's column and ring (the colour code's growth sky)

pyr_pyramid.about: VFX-16: the everyday pyramid's own colours (tools/build-pyramids.py), for its send-out burst and its shards

eventsAbout: VFX-14: statuses, stat changes and short effects on the stage (logic/battle-looks.js picks what plays; battle-looks.js plays it). A burst: sprite (a strip in sprites), ramp (a ramps id, or type: the move's type), n of them every ms apart, each living life ms, rising vy m/s, spread m apart, at y (feet, mid or top of the Billie), scale k (a whole number), a fixed frame (else it plays), flip (upside down), glow (its white core adds). A status (brn, par, slp, confused) and an effect (soaked, fork): start when it begins, loop while it lasts (one every ms), tick on its turn (a burn's hurt, a lost turn, a turn asleep), end when it goes; tint and tintA: the sprite's tint under Reduced motion (the meaning without the motion); flicker: a burn's warm flicker on the sprite, an amount per 12 fps cell; hold: a lost turn's held frame (ms) and edge its flash; idle: asleep's slower (slow x the clock), lower (sink px) idle with its head down (droop); orbit: n stars round its head, r its half-heights, a turn in turnMs; bonk: hitting itself. stat: chevrons up or down, sharply times as many for a change of 2 stages or more. protect and shield: discs of hex cells (shield_hex) round it, cells by quality 0-3, r and h in its half-heights, frame (shown, eroded to a: dithered, so the Billie shows through), flashFrame (a block, flashMs, at full strength), crackFrame (a worn cell: the shield's turns used up). delayed: a mark in the sky over the side it will land on, y m up; stones: n pebbles r m round each Billie's feet on that side, glint now and then. glint: a Perk, held item, Gene or type passive firing (the battle's by report), one after another gapMs apart, in the source's ramp (a passive: its type's). pulseMs: under Calm, a lasting loop pulses once a turn for this long; cells: the most lasting-look particles at once by quality 0-3.

brn.about: burned: embers rise, a warm flicker, a lick of flame on its turn

par.about: paralyzed: sparks jump; a lost turn holds a frame and flashes a gold edge

slp.about: asleep: Z's rise from a slower, lower idle, head down; a pop on waking

confused.about: confused: three stars orbit its head; hitting itself, a bonk star

broken.about: a robot's (or an Augment's) broken part keeps a move from it: sparks sputter (it showed flames before)

protect.about: Protect and Skim Guard: a hex bubble in front of it while it lasts (this turn), flashing on a block

shield.about: an Alpha's (or a boss phase's) shield: a dome of hex cells round it; a cell cracks for each turn it wears down; it flashes when it takes the edge off a hit; it shatters when it fades

soaked.about: Soaked: drips fall off it while it lasts

fork.about: Fork: a flickering copy of it (two 12 fps cells shown in every four), offset dx m; fade its strength

delayed.about: a delayed hit: a mark in the sky over the side it lands on, in the move's type, until it lands

stones.about: sharp stones: pebbles round the feet on that side; one glints now and then

glint.about: a Perk, held item, Gene or type passive firing: a small glint on its Billie in the source's colour

events.about: VFX-16: the battle's flow moments (stage ms; counts are particles before the budget): vs the VS splash (foes: the run roles that get one, rivals: trainer ids that are the rival, scale: the portraits' whole-number scale at most, hold: ms it stays, all inside trainerIn's 1150); sendOut the Billie dithering in from its feet up over riseMs after the pyramid lands, a burst in its type, the pyramid kind's ramp (kinds), a glint for a Coat or a Prime build; recall a beam back to the trainer's hand (w stage px) while it dithers out over outMs; catch each wobble squashes the pyramid (squash) and puffs dust, a seal rings in the type, an escape throws shards in the pyramid's colours; faint the hurt pose held holdMs, it sinks and dithers out over outMs with a dust puff, a bot sheds its limbs with sparks and bolts, then smoke; levelUp a column of light (n motes over h m) and a ring on the right Billie; victory the winners cheer with sparkles; defeat your side fades over fadeMs; item the item's icon flies from the bag to the Billie over flyMs (inside the line's reading time: no time added). Each keeps its event's time or less.

types.about: VFX-11: the type kits: what a family's steps draw with in each type (a step's spr names a role: shot, impact, small, bits; its ramp is the kit's unless it names one; path kit is the kit's path), the kit's motion (flicker: its bits float up; zigzag: a held frame doubled; the rest come from its path and its cast and hit steps) and its light (the ramp's light colour, k its strength, ms how long, at most 300). The Bureau's is a Bureau bot's move, whatever its type. cast plays at a family's wind-up on the attacker, hit at its hit on the target

Bureau.about: a Bureau bot's move: paper, square, stamped in from above, in the red family; no drawn words (SY-5 owns them)
